Now hiring

Personal Injury Associate Attorney

  • Roseville, CA
  • Remote
  • Full-time

$150,000–$175,000per year, depending on experience, plus bonus

Apply now See the role
30+Years of history
11California locations
$1B+Recovered for clients
10.0Avvo rating

We’re looking for someone to bank on. We’re growing, and we’re adding a new Litigation Attorney seat. This is not a job where you’re one of 80 associates working a quota. We have six attorneys. You’ll work directly with our founder, try cases, and see the results of your work.

Responsibilities

  • Run a personal injury litigation caseload from filing through trial: auto, truck, motorcycle, pedestrian, premises liability, wrongful death, and TBI cases
  • Draft pleadings, discovery, and motions
  • Take and defend depositions, including experts
  • Handle hearings, mediations, and settlement negotiations
  • Try cases alongside Frank and our trial team
  • Work with your dedicated paralegal to keep every case moving

Qualifications

  • An active California State Bar license in good standing
  • 2+ years of personal injury litigation experience

Required Skills

  • A fighter’s mindset: you push for full value, not the first offer
  • Strong writing, negotiation, and case management skills
  • The discipline to thrive working remotely, and willingness to travel for court

Why this role is different

01

Learn from Frank Penney

Frank was named the 2023 Consumer Attorney of the Year by Consumer Attorneys of California. The award recognized his $10.5M federal wrongful death verdict, which led to safety improvements in national parks across the country. He also serves as a Pro Tem Judge and Judicial Arbitrator in Placer County. You’ll work alongside him on case strategy and in trial.

02

You’ll go to trial

We prepare cases to be tried, and we try them. You’ll get courtroom experience that many 2–5 year attorneys never get.

03

Small team, real access

No layers of partners between you and the decisions. Your ideas get heard, and your wins get noticed.

04

Built to last

We have 30+ years of history, 11 locations across California, and a 10.0 Avvo rating. We’ve been named Super Lawyers Top 25 Sacramento and won Best of the Bar. This is a stable platform, not a startup gamble.

05

We mean the mission

We treat clients like family. That’s in our client reviews, and it’s how we give back. When we donated $12,000 to the Sacramento Children’s Home, we closed the office so the whole team could be there.

Pay range and compensation package

Base salary

$150,000–$175,000, depending on experience, plus bonus

Fully remote

Live anywhere, and the firm pays your travel to court appearances

Your own paralegal

A dedicated paralegal on your cases

Benefits

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Retirement

401(k)

Time off

Paid time off and paid holidays

Professional costs

Bar dues paid by the firm
